## Tutorials

The Int() function returns the integer part of a number.

Note:Ifnumberis negative, this function returns 
the first negative integer less than or equal tonumber.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Int(756.43) AS IntNum;

---

Int(
number
)

---

SELECT Int(Price) AS IntNum FROM Products;
```

## Tutorials

The Max() function returns the maximum value in a set of values.

Note:See also theMin()function.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Max(Price) AS LargestPrice FROM Products;

---

Max(
expression
)
```

## Tutorials

The Min() function returns the minimum value in a set of values.

Note:See also theMax()function.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT 
  Min(Price) AS 
  SmallestPrice FROM Products;

---

expression
)
```

### Code Examples

```

seed
```
